title: Hands-on with the compact Xbox Nano controller
excerpt: Microsoft's tiny new Xbox Nano controller is designed specifically for younger users and people with smaller hands.
body_html:
Microsoft has introduced a new, highly compact peripheral known as the Xbox Nano controller. Built specifically for younger individuals and anyone with smaller hands, the device is small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

First impressions of the hardware highlight its surprisingly comfortable feel during use, despite its miniature dimensions. The compact device aims to provide an alternative option for gamers who find standard-sized controllers difficult to handle.
